text: Training Objectives: This major aims to cultivate well-rounded individuals with moral integrity, intelligence, physical fitness, aesthetic appreciation, and labor skills. Students will master the fundamental knowledge of food science and engineering, possess strong information acquisition and professional practical abilities, and have an innovative mindset, international perspective, and sustainable development awareness. They will be capable of engaging in engineering design, production management, product development, scientific research, and other related work in the food industry and related fields as high-quality engineering and technical talents.Core Courses: Commonly include Food Biochemistry, Food Microbiology, Food Chemistry and Nutrition, Food Safety, Principles of Food Engineering, Principles of Food Technology, Food Analysis, Food Machinery and Equipment, Food Factory Design and Environmental Protection, etc.Professional Characteristics: Some universities' Food Science and Engineering programs have distinct features. For instance, the Food Science and Engineering major at Xihua University has multiple provincial-level platforms, such as the Key Laboratory of Food Microbiology of Sichuan Province, and stands out in areas like food nutrition and safety, agricultural product storage and processing, and condiment fermentation engineering. The Food Science and Engineering program at Guangdong University of Petrochemical Technology, on the other hand, focuses on the western part of Guangdong and the South China region. Through school-enterprise cooperation and the "3+1" order class model, it aims to cultivate applied engineering and technical talents who can meet the needs of modern food industry and local economic development.
